'''Chunte's''' was a business located in [[Grid 19]] of the [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]]. It presumably burned down along with the other businesses located on the same block as the [[Soft Heart Cantina]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], in a fire officially attributed to arson.

==Behind the scenes==
The full name of this establishment is not given.
